steps.content: You clutch Hilda's brooch, its metal teeth biting into your palm. Turning your back on the manor, you walk into the roaring downpour.
A helicopter's searchlight pins you in its glare. Through the curtain of rain, you decipher the blinking message:
Survivor spotted. Did you send the radio signal?
Yes. It's you, and it has to be you.

Through the heavy rain, the world dissolves into a blur. You can only make out the DisCity soldiers surrounding you from all directions. Once they confirm you're not a Sinner, cold, standard-issue handcuffs click shut around your wrists.
Meanwhile, more troops swarm the front hall, forming a wide, cautious perimeter around Hilda. They fear the Mania radiating from her.
In the harsh lights, her silhouette seems small and achingly isolated, trapped between the soldiers and the chaotic Mania swirling around her.
Soon, sporadic gunshots crackle. They are closing in.
In response, the code strips of Mania fly from her hands, striking down her assailants with deadly precision. She feigns rage, glaring at you behind the protective wall of soldiers.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ${PlayerName}. I never thought you would be the one to betray me...
She fights on, a desperate, final performance.
Glory. Dignity. Order. Loyalty.
The words she spits into the chaos are still dripping with the unmistakable arrogance of the metropoles.
As the soldiers breach the hall through flames and Mania, shouting for her surrender, a laugh escapes her lips. And she lets go. All her remaining Mania erupts in a single, devastating wave.

steps.speaker: DisCity Agent
steps.content: Stop her! Command wants her alive!
Throughout it all, her gaze never once leaves you.
You vaguely make out symbols forming within the Mania—shapes that feel somehow both deeply familiar and utterly alien.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: A full circle for a space, crescents for dots and dashes. It's a modified Morse code. Discreet, but efficient.
The symbols of the full moon and crescent moon shine brilliantly, mirroring each other in the sky.
They drift into alignment behind her, speaking only to you.
They are her final confession, hidden beneath her words.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content:
Dream on, you DisCity hyenas.
<i><color=#fb9259>Thank you.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content:
I will never let you lay hands on my intelligence.
<i><color=#fb9259>It's a promise.</color><i>
Before the DisCity soldiers can take another step, she drags the glass across her neck.
In her final moments, a storm of Mania detonates around her. The world shatters; the very space you stand in begins to implode. Your LINK connection severs with a silent, violent snap.
